definitions.explanation: To take hold of something with your hand.
To capture an image. Written as {撮|と}る for photos.
To acquire something like a reservation, license, or vacation time.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}を{取|と}ってください。
{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}りましょう。
{休|やす}みを{取|と}りたいです。
examples.english: I want to take time off.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{取|と}る (take X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state or ongoing action. {取|と}っている = 'have taken' or 'is taking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{塩|しお}を{取|と}る (pass the salt)
・{休|やす}みを{取|と}る (take time off)
・{予約|よやく}を{取|と}る (make a reservation)
・{年|とし}を{取|と}る (get older)

Multiple kanji: {取|と}る (general take), {撮|と}る (photos), {採|と}る (harvest/collect). Very versatile verb.
